prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one standalone 16:9 film frame for a premium website explaining camera-angle exploration, not a website mockup. New cinematic universe: a tense, stylish Mediterranean caper in bright late-afternoon light. On the sunlit rooftop terrace of an old coral-pink Art Deco hotel above turquoise sea, a confident fictional woman in her thirties with a dark curly bob, wearing an ivory linen trouser suit over a coral silk blouse, discreetly slides a small plain cream envelope across a round cobalt-blue bistro table to a fictional man in his thirties with short dark hair and a teal open-collar shirt. The man turns his head slightly toward a third adult man approaching from a coral arched doorway in the background, in a mustard linen jacket. Human expressions, blocking and readable hands carry the story. A pale cream canvas awning billows above, long amber shadows, blue glazed floor tiles, one citrus tree, sea beyond the balustrade. Camera angle: eye-level medium two-shot with a 50mm cinematic lens, woman's face three-quarter toward camera on left, man on right, both hands and envelope visible, the third figure small but readable in the background. Beautiful rich coral/turquoise/ivory color, restrained film grain, premium live-action anamorphic movie photography with natural skin, believable architecture and physical sunlight. Elegant visual tension, not commercial stock photography, no glossy plastic, no violence. The frame is a single decisive moment, not a montage. No text, no UI, no borders, no watermarks, no brand marks. All people fictional adults. 16:9 widescreen.

Use case: identity-preserve / cinematic camera-angle variation. Reference image is the SAME FILM SCENE and the same three fictional adults; keep faces, hairstyles, exact ivory suit/coral blouse, teal shirt, mustard jacket, blue round table, cream envelope, lemon tree, coral Art Deco hotel, Mediterranean turquoise sea, late-afternoon light and setting consistent. Create ONE entirely new 16:9 camera view of this SAME decisive moment, not a crop. Angle A: WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT from several metres back, eye level with a 24mm lens. Both seated main characters and chairs are fully visible at the small blue table on the left half; third man approaching the arched hotel doorway on the right, expansive terrace and blue tiles, white canopy overhead and big turquoise sea vista in the distance. The woman's hand passes the cream envelope on the table. Human blocking readable; architecture and space dominate, characters about one-third of image height. It should differ unmistakably from the provided medium close shot while maintaining story continuity. Premium colorful live-action film photography, coral pink, cobalt and turquoise, ivory and honey light. No UI, panels, text, captions, logos or watermark. One widescreen frame only.

Use case: identity-preserve / cinematic camera-angle variation. Reference is the SAME scene and same three fictional adults. The round blue table, envelope between their reaching hands and two seated characters are central, geometric blue floor tiles and long golden shadows become graphic foreground; the approaching man's head and mustard shoulders enter from the lower right, the turquoise sea is a small band beyond the far coral railing. This is not a crop or a drone landscape. Show the spatial triangle of the three characters, a distinct director's overhead coverage option. Keep a physically plausible single action and realistic anatomy. Beautiful premium 35mm live-action caper movie, rich but natural colors, same light and location, not an illustration or game render. No UI, split screen, panels, text, logos or watermarks. One widescreen frame.
